Professional Experience

Lead cross functional teams using Agile methodology and scrum practices. Product development, Product management, Onsite - Offshore transition. Collaboration with Pre-Sales team to collects input/data for customer, competitor, and market analysis, Able to work closely with management to prioritize business and information needs, liaise with project board and respective stakeholders during the entire project lifecycle. Presentation to stakeholders on Product features/new developments ~ functions, features. Ability to multi-task and prioritize deliverable, Excellent analytical skills with a good problem-solving attitude. Ensure resource availability and allocation. Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills; Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience in managing projects in a multi-cultural environment; Experience in managing remote teams. Premier Financial Service’s firms – Digital Banking Transformation Solution, Trading and Settlement process, IT Services companies in India, USA, UK, and Japan. Equity and Derivatives Stock exchanges & Clearing Corporations. • Health Care – Pharma Marketing, Automated Customer fulfilment response

management. Comprehensive knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC), Agile- Scrum, KANBAN, Iterative and Waterfall methodology. Building Bulk Data feeds generation and distribution capability via Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Fabric applications. Extensive experience in gathering and documenting business requirements. Proficient in writing Business Requirement Document (BRD), Functional Requirement Document (FRD) and detailing into System Requirement Specification (SRS). Excellent in performing Gap Analysis and proficient in documenting AS - IS and To - Be business processes.
Quality assurance (QA) experience in developing and reviewing test plans, test case, using Defect-Tracking Tool to address bugs/issues as required.
Employment History
London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG): DaaS (Data-as a- Service) – London, UK Nov 2023 - Feb 2025
Sr. Manager - Business Analyst
Project - Bulk Data Feeds generation and Distribution capability Domain – DaaS (Data-as a- Service)/Data Product. DaaS - It is the data that is available in the DaaS Platform and has been published as a Product. Data as a Product is the product management principles to data with focus on ownership, usability, and quality.

This includes building the Bulk Data feeds generation and distribution capability via Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Fabric applications to address data usability issues.
•
Files are retrieved via a series of API endpoints that allow clients to request data on a frequency that meets their needs. The two data file types are:
o Request initialization files o Request incremental files
Generate initialization and incremental files for each bulk data feed



product when updated data is received from MS Purview. These queries are saved, and then run at pre-defined times in MS Fabric, and the resulting files stored in Azure Cloud Storage. Clients would make API calls to request initialization or incremental updates to the Bulk Data Feed products that they have subscribed to, and the API would return URLs of the file generated by the above process to the client. The client would access the URLs and download the desired files locally into their system.
Responsibilities: • • Run the Blob Storage Reader pipeline for latest version of the data files. • Remove the older versions of the files in Manifest Lakehouse in MS Fabric. • Run the Query_Builder_Output Pipeline under Query_Builder_Output Lakehouse. • When the query runs successfully, would generate the URLs that the customer can access
Check for the initialization files and initialization files within Blob storage in MS Fabric
for the subscribed data products.

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG):
DaaS (Data-as a- Service) – London, UK Nov 2023 - Feb 2025
Sr. Manager - Business Analyst
Project - Bulk Data Feeds generation and Distribution capability
Domain – DaaS (Data-as a- Service)/Data Product.
DaaS - It is the data that is available in the DaaS Platform and has been
published as a Product. Data as a Product is the product management
principles to data with focus on ownership, usability, and quality.
This includes building the Bulk Data feeds generation and distribution
capability via Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Fabric applications to address
data usability issues.
Files are retrieved via a series of API endpoints that allow clients to
request data on a frequency that meets their needs. The two data file
types are:
o Request initialization files
o Request incremental files
Generate initialization and incremental files for each bulk data feed
product when updated data is received from MS Purview.
These queries are saved, and then run at pre-defined times in MS
Fabric, and the resulting files stored in Azure Cloud Storage.
Clients would make API calls to request initialization or incremental
updates to the Bulk Data Feed products that they have subscribed to,
and the API would return URLs of the file generated by the above
process to the client.
The client would access the URLs and download the desired files
locally into their system.
Responsibilities:
Run the Blob Storage Reader pipeline for latest version of the data files.
Remove the older versions of the files in Manifest Lakehouse in MS Fabric.
Run the Query_Builder_Output Pipeline under Query_Builder_Output Lakehouse.
When the query runs successfully, would generate the URLs that the customer can access
Check for the initialization files and initialization files within Blob storage in MS Fabric
for the subscribed data products.
Working directly with the Product Manager and assisting to maintain Product Backlog,
Sprint Planning, Daily Stand Up.
Participated in Scrum, and Sprint Ceremonies - Retrospective Meetings.

Lead Business Analyst
Project - JSND - Unemployment Insurance Modernization
Domain – Unemployment Insurance claim processing
Job Service North Dakota (JSND) serves as the North Dakota state’s premiere
source for workforce assistance programs. Whether an individual is an
employee, employer or seeking employment, training, or labor market
information; Job Service can provide an array of resources to assist each
customer on an individual basis.
The JSND Unemployment Insurance Modernization project consists of
modernizing Microsoft Access applications to a Web based application to
enhance security and improve client access. The focus is reducing vendor
reliance and allowing for future enhancements.
Responsibilities:
Leading a 10-member team of FTEs & Contractors comprising of Business Analysts,

Elevate is a Digital Banking Transformation Solution that helps financial
institutions revolutionize their underlying processes, capabilities, and
technologies. Elevate enable banks into a thriving digital ecosystem moving
way beyond Omni-channel. It is a completely integrated Omni-channel digital

Collaborated with UK based business stakeholders in creation of Product Backlog (PBI)

Family-Now A comprehensive Child Welfare management solution that

DaaS - It is the data that is available in the DaaS Platform and has been

This includes building the Bulk Data feeds generation and distribution

data usability issues.
Files are retrieved via a series of API endpoints that allow clients to
request data on a frequency that meets their needs. The two data file
types are:
o Request initialization files
o Request incremental files
Generate initialization and incremental files for each bulk data feed
product when updated data is received from MS Purview.
These queries are saved, and then run at pre-defined times in MS
Fabric, and the resulting files stored in Azure Cloud Storage.
Clients would make API calls to request initialization or incremental
updates to the Bulk Data Feed products that they have subscribed to,
and the API would return URLs of the file generated by the above
process to the client.
The client would access the URLs and download the desired files
locally into their system.

Run the Blob Storage Reader pipeline for latest version of the data files.

Run the Query_Builder_Output Pipeline under Query_Builder_Output Lakehouse.

Check for the initialization files and initialization files within Blob storage in MS Fabric
